designationHistory.indexText: Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge (originally named Anahuac) was established in 1963 to provide wintering and migration habitat for ducks and geese.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
